name: weather station
description: A mast with a panel that counts sols, shows the air temperature now, pulses a signal every Mars hour, and raises a red flag when it is colder than -70 C.
author: sample

did_you_know.text: A typical day at Jezero runs from about 195 K (-78 C) just before dawn to about 247 K (-26 C) mid-afternoon, averaged hour by hour over a full Mars year measured by Perseverance.
